claim_results.claim: Risk 3: Brindleyplace LOI lapses before TRL 7 (Low–Medium) — Sarah Chen's pipeline holds two alternative commercial portfolio sites; M15 TRL validation includes a 3-month buffer to M18
claim_results.vault_text: Not in vault. Vault names only Sheffield (paid pilot) and Brindleyplace (LOI) as current customers/pilots.
claim_results.issue: The claim that 'Sarah Chen's pipeline holds two alternative commercial portfolio sites' is Forge invention — there is no evidence in the vault that two alternative commercial portfolio sites exist as named pipeline opportunities. This is the kind of unsupported specific number that assessors penalise (per IUK guidance chunk 4: 'Market size not credible' / 'Risks not identified'). RECOMMENDED FIX: replace with verifiable framing such as 'Sarah Chen leads an ongoing commercial pipeline development workstream, with WP6 explicitly tasked with building a Phase 2 operator pipeline as a project deliverable'. The 3-month M15→M18 buffer is fine as project-plan logic.

red_flag_checks.red_flag: Generic risks ('project might take longer than expected') rather than project-specific risks
red_flag_checks.notes: All four risks are specific to ThermaSync's project: algorithm scale-up, BMS integration, commercial-pilot LOI, Heat Network Zoning. Each has a project-specific mitigation referencing named team members or contingency mechanics.

red_flag_checks.red_flag: Overloaded timelines where the same person leads multiple parallel work packages beyond capacity
red_flag_checks.notes: Okafor leads WP2 (M1–M6) and co-leads WP4 (M6–M15) and WP5 (M9–M18). WP2 completes before WP4 ramps; WP4 and WP5 overlap M9–M15, but James co-leads with Webb (WP4) and Chen (WP5). Plausible. Nair carries WP1 across the whole project, which is standard for a project director role. No obvious >100% allocation in the named-leads view, but the team should run a person-month calculation against actual time allocation before submission — assessors do this.

red_flag_checks.red_flag: Milestone descriptions that cannot be objectively assessed
red_flag_checks.notes: All milestones are quantified or binary: '23% peak target on 14-node simulation', '50 production-grade controllers delivered', '≥18% peak reduction over 3 months live operation', 'TRL 7 sign-off', '≥5 named Phase 2 operators'. All objectively assessable.

red_flag_checks.red_flag: Team lacks directly relevant technical expertise
red_flag_checks.notes: Okafor's ESO-trial track record (19% peak reduction on 18k customers) is directly analogous to the project's core technical challenge. Nair's Siemens BMS / £280k IUK co-I experience covers the building-automation domain. Strong fit.
All three core team members' credentials verified verbatim against company-profile.md. Advisory board verified. Subcontractor verified. Marcus Webb verified.
